q2_gaps: privative / temporal adjectives — "former", "ex-", "one-time", "would-be": a modifier that cancels the head noun's present applicability has no licensed encoding, and the only nearby rule ("lexical antonyms are not negation — only an explicit not/n't/no/never sets strength 0.0") points the wrong way
notes: "former municipality" is rendered by analogy to the *Cessation* bundle (past positive + same-atom strength-0 denial), which is semantically exactly right and the closest licensed shape, though cessation as written is defined over an event symbol rather than a copular atom. Everything else matches the instruction set's own worked examples: "Thornmere is a village in Calderwick" for `LocatedIn`, "the Brindle estuary" for the name-plus-lowercase-kind split, and place-in-place containment for `(LocatedIn pieria greece)`.
